1.1.translation: On the holy field of Kurukṣetra, assembled together, eager to fight...

1.2.text: Marjayante mahā-bhāgā / bhīṣmaṁ ca droṇam ca mādhavam
1.2.translation: O Sañjaya, after my sons and the sons of Pandu assembled...

3.35.text: Śreyān svabhāvo guṇavān / tat sangas tu sadoṣavat
3.35.translation: It is far better to discharge one's prescribed duty...

18.66.text: Sarva-dharmān parityajya / mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
18.66.translation: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me...
